program_countdown: 1 of the scored candidates carry a `program`. At 5 this stops enumerating and returns a breeding set instead — the best programs so far, the worst for contrast, and the factors on which the two groups differ, which is the material for writing a better one. 4 more to go. These programs carry no `holes`, and that is what keeps proposing on the breeding set: with nothing named inside a program there is no neighbourhood to enumerate, so the record hands back the best and the worst and asks you to write the next one yourself. Naming one hole changes that — a hole is a formula, so its edits are defined, generation varies one hole at a time, and a gain becomes attributable to a component instead of to a whole rewrite. The skeleton is usually something you looked up; the holes are what this campaign is actually searching.
